newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Fin Min 1-yr bond avg yield hits 20.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Fin Min 1-yr bond avg yield hits 20.35 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak finance ministry auction of one-year, 11-percent state bonds on Tuesday rose to 20.349 percent from 19.388 percent in the last auction of similar bonds on August 5, the central bank (NBS) said.
The ministry acepted bids worth 2.38 billion crowns ($68.6 million) with demand totalling 2.95 billion crowns.
Minimum accepted yield was 19.301 percent while the maximum yield hit 21.40 percent, the NBS, which conducted the auction, said in a statement.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer in state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.936 billion crowns for the first seven months of this year from 13.209 billion in the January-June period of 1997.
